description: Four gate channels running at four different multiples of one clock, each filling itself with random gates until it is told to loop

params.text: Sets the clock speed within the band picked by the switch beside it
Picks the band the speed knobs and the oscillator work in, a fast one or a slow one
Trims the clock speed around the setting of the larger knob
Sets how much of each clock period the gates stay high
Holds that channel repeating the pattern it has, instead of drawing a new random value at every step

inputs.text: Adds to the clock speed, one volt for one volt of the speed knob's range, and the total is clamped at the ends of the band
Adds to the gate width, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt

outputs.text: A 5V gate from that channel, at its own multiple of the clock period
The master clock gate, 5V while it is high
The square wave from the built-in oscillator, ±5V, at 40Hz to 200Hz in the slow band and up in the kilohertz in the fast one

inputs.0:
±5V · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
